title: Special Sign Regulations for the Fulton Mall Subdistrict
previewText: Any erection of a new sign, or alteration (including a change in graphic representation on an existing sign), reconstruction or replacement of an existing sign, shall be subject to the special sign regulations of this Section, inclusive.
